summary.text: Dennis Mahoney, an Independent, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Pennsylvania's 3rd Congressional District to Chris Rabb.
His campaign described his career in disaster relief and long-term development and his work on cross-sector coalitions in Philadelphia.

paragraphs.text: Mahoney is from South Philadelphia and was 34 years old as of September 2026, according to The Philadelphia Inquirer.

He has worked in disaster relief and humanitarian aid for about a decade, including through Food for the Hungry and a former Washington, D.C., church, and the Inquirer reports he has dispatched aid after hurricanes in the United States and Puerto Rico and in poverty crises in 18 countries.
According to his Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey, he founded AOI Solutions, a firm focused on disaster relief and humanitarian response.
Mahoney was a first-time candidate who told the Inquirer he has belonged to both major parties.
He qualified for the ballot with about 19,000 petition signatures, according to the Inquirer and his survey.
His campaign listed five platform commitments: ending the benefits cliff, housing, neighborhood connectivity, family stability and generational wealth.
He received 6.4% of the vote to Chris Rabb's 93.6%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.

sources.title: Independent Dennis Mahoney is trying to defeat Chris Rabb in November
